text:
maria: Quick sanity check needed — MercuryBank sent a security questionnaire asking for details on our logging/redaction + who can access logs. Draft answer below, want to make sure I'm not overstating anything before I return to them.

maria: Draft excerpt for SQ: "We do not retain raw user prompts or PII in logs. Our ingestion pipeline redacts email addresses, payment tokens, SSNs, and full prompt_text fields before persistence. Logs are encrypted at rest and access-controlled; only authorized SRE and security roles have time-limited access. Subprocessors that receive aggregated metrics or masked logs are listed in our subprocessor inventory."

maria: Example log we were asked to justify redaction on:
```
INFO user=12345 action=completion prompt_text="Transfer $500 to john@example.com confirm?" model=gpt-4x
```

tim: That draft is okay but be explicit that `prompt_text` is redacted at ingest. We hash `user` IDs for debugging traces, we never store cleartext emails or financial tokens. Also mention that debug dumps require an access approval and are audited.

ashley: +1. For the SQ I'd write: we perform field-level redaction (email, phone, ssn, payment_token, prompt_text) via our redact pipeline, and we emit only masked traces to monitoring. Datadog receives masked/aggregated logs; raw artifacts go to S3 encrypted with envelope encryption and customer keys in KMS where applicable.

ashley: Also add this line: "Subprocessor disclosure and cross-border transfer info available in our inventory (link provided)." that'll satisfy legal reviewers.

sec-bot: Subprocessor inventory snapshot: Datadog (logs/metrics), S3 (storage), GCP Cloud KMS (key management), PagerDuty (alerts). Inventory URL: https://redwood.internal/subprocessors (access: redwood-employee). Last updated: 2025-06-01.

tim: One policy note: we treat emails and IPs as PII for SQ purposes. If MercuryBank requests raw prompt retention for debugging we require: 1) signed data processing addendum, 2) scoped access approval ticket, 3) time-limited retention and audit log. Please don't promise on-call will hand over raw dumps without that.

julie: I'll open an access approval template for MercuryBank if they push for raw logs — will create ticket P-ACC-232 and tag legal + privacy. I'll include the retention policy excerpt and runbook for redaction.

maria: Perfect. Action items: Julie -> create P-ACC-232 and attach runbook; Tim -> confirm full list of redact fields (I'll copy into the SQ); Ashley -> attach subprocessor inventory link to the response. I'll update the SQ and send to legal for sign-off, then back to the customer. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

tim: Sounds good. Ping me if legal wants exact wording for the hashing/trace protocol.

ashley: Added one small tweak: mention that logs streamed to third parties are at most pseudonymized and never include prompt_text.

maria: Sending updated draft to legal now, will post final answer here when done.
